text.en:
The term of the Presidential Committee to Study Government Corporations (PCSGC) is extended up to
September 30, 1978 and it is further directed that the Committee submit its report to the President/Prime
Minister on or before said date.

An appropriation of P150,000.00 is authorized for the use of the Committee, in addition to whatever
unexpended balance it may have out of its existing appropriation as of June 30, 1978.
This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 30th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, Nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
